name: Brookside Mental Health Rehabilitation Center
description: The Project consists of the retrofit and adaptive reuse of an existing one-story, wood-framed building to create a 46-bed MHRC facility including new care suites, sleeping rooms, medical and wellness spaces, staff offices, as well as recreational and dining areas. The construction consists of hazardous material abatement, selective demolition, structural seismic upgrades, interior and exterior remodel and replacement of all MEP systems. Scope also includes upgrading commercial kitchen, installation of new fire protection, security, and access control systems, and providing new doors, windows, finishes, and anti-ligature fixtures throughout. Site improvements include new accessible entries, parking and path of travel upgrades, landscape enhancements, C3 bioretention planters, new covered patios, trash enclosure and emergency generator installation.

notes.full_text:
The budgetary estimate for the scope of work is approximately $19,000,000.
Attendance at least one, pre-bid conference / site visit is
mandatory
. Pre-Bid conferences will be held on Tuesday, November 4, 2025 at 10:00 a.m. and Thursday, November 6, 2025 at 2:00 p.m. at 847B Brookside Drive, Richmond, CA. All participants are required to sign in at the site. The site visit is expected to take approximately 1.5 hours. If mandatory, failure to attend or arrival after the material start of the meeting will render bid ineligible.

name: Old Juvenile Hall Demolition
location: Works Department Conference Room G in BLDG 500, 255 Glacier Drive, Martinez, California

notes.full_text:
The project includes two phases:
Phase 1 - Provide security fencing along the perimeter of the scope of work area. - Installation of new temporary contractor laydown area. - Installation of H-piles to support existing walls and new concrete retaining walls. - Infill existing windows at stairwells to remain. - Installation of new steel for fence truss support and new chain link fence at new concrete wall. - Installation of the new emergency generator, concrete pad, chain link enclosure, conduits, feeders, panels, etc. Provide a fully functioning emergency generator power connection into the electrical panel in the Monticello basement. - Installation of new concrete/chain link security wall at play yard east. Installation of chain link security fencing at basketball court area north and east sides. - Removal and abatement of all hazardous materials indicated on the contract documents and hazardous reports provided by owner.
Phase 2 - Removal of existing emergency generator, chain link enclosure, and all remaining electrical elements between the existing generator and the new generator locations. - All other demolition or new construction activities indicated on the contract documents include: o The demolition and removal of the old juvenile hall, boys’ and girls’ wings, classroom building and site features shown to be removed. o Removal of existing buildings/footings, concrete security walls, utility tunnels, and other building features defined on the drawings. Removal of all mechanical, electrical, fire alarm, fire sprinklers, and plumbing elements within the building. o Removal of all site utilities shown to be removed to their point of connection. Cap utility connections at their source. o Removal of hardscape materials, trees, shrubs, fencing, concrete walls, security fencing & enclosures. - Install new storm drains and drop inlets. - Backfill trenches to 90% compaction. Provide as-built drawings of all underground utilities removed. - Import engineered fill and grading per documents - Install new irrigation system, landscaping, and hydroseed site per contract documents.
The estimated construction contract cost (Base bid) is $6,217,000.00, including a $200,000 owner’s contingency.
A pre-bid conference will be held on October 21, 2025 at 11:00 a.m., at the Training Center, 100 Glacier Dr., Martinez, CA 94553. Discussion will cover recommended outreach efforts, resources, and any other subjects of interest to attendees. Immediately following the pre-bid conference on October 21, 2025, there will be an in- person Job Site Visit at 202 Glacier Dr., Martinez, CA 94553.
**Because of the restrictive nature of the facilities, the exterior of the buildings and site will only be open for inspection by bidders on October 21, 2025.
